findings.detail: The source schedule reports total investments at 220.3% of member's capital, but the reviewed artifact reports pct_sum=0.0%.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate check. The filing's schedule total line shows fair value of 259,073 and 220.3% of member's capital for total non-controlled-non-affiliated Portfolio Company investments, while the flag reports pct_sum=0.0%. The nonzero source percentage grounds an extraction gap in the percent-of-member-capital field.
